Purpose: Start here: page index, how to add a site, how to set alert targets
How_Calculated: Home = start page: the index of every page (click a button to open it; every page has a Home button top left), how to add or remove a site (max 6 sites in the report) and how to set alert targets (every site follows the BD thresholds unless a site row overrides a KPI). Sites in this report: code, name, WMS engine and configuration status.
How_To_Configure: Sites and alert targets: Hypercare_KPI_Inputs.xlsx (SharePoint OSS warehousing data and GenAI, Data Projects/PRIME ELS/Hypercare KPI) -> py tools/apply_inputs.py; new site: py tools/add_site.py <CODE>; page texts: config/page_guide.csv Purpose.

Purpose: The 6 hypercare KPIs today vs target, previous day and forecast; what to do now
How_Calculated: Six hypercare pillars. Actual = report day (shift day starting at Cfg_Site.Shift1_Start, site-local time). Status: Higher-is-better KPIs are CRITICAL below Crit_At and WARNING below Warn_At; Lower-is-better the opposite. Prediction: production = current 3-hour run rate projected to end of shift day; TTAT = 7-day linear trend for the next day; utilisation = current occupied + net in-minus-out rate x PRED_HORIZON_H. What to do now = every alert rule in WARNING / CRITICAL, critical first, with its recommended action and owner.
How_To_Configure: Targets / warning / critical: type them on the Config & Health page (threshold inputs) - they override Cfg_Threshold at once; clear the box (eraser) to fall back to Cfg_Threshold. Permanent per-site values: Cfg_Threshold (Site = <SiteCode> rows override the '*' default). Verdict / outlook texts: Cfg_RCA. Actions / owners: Cfg_AlertRule.

Purpose: Every alert rule: status, actual vs target, why, numbers, diagnosis, action
How_Calculated: Every rule of Cfg_AlertRule (the Excel ALERTS sheet + new hypercare rules) evaluated against its KPI threshold for the report day: Actual, Target (warning / critical), Prediction, probable cause and recommended action. Rules that need a process the site does not run (Has_Production / Has_LevelA / Has_HOFF = 0) show N/A.
How_To_Configure: Rules, owners, insights and actions: Cfg_AlertRule. Thresholds: page inputs on Config & Health (override) or Cfg_Threshold (saved per site). Fix-order text: Cfg_RCA (NARRATIVE).

Purpose: One-page daily report + hour-by-hour early warning (Excel DAILY / HOURLY)
How_Calculated: LEFT = Excel DAILY_REPORT: every hypercare KPI of the report day with value, target, status and prediction. RIGHT = Excel HOURLY_ALERT for any site: pallets moved by RF users per hour vs the same hour over the last LOOKBACK days (status from HOUR_VS_BASE), active users, inbound / outbound trucks and their turnaround in that hour, produced pallets (production sites) and the hourly verdict.
How_To_Configure: Hour status limits: Cfg_Threshold HOUR_VS_BASE, MIN_BASE, LOOKBACK. Verdict texts: Cfg_RCA (Type HOURLY). Shift-day start: Cfg_Site.Shift1_Start.

Purpose: What is waiting where right now (trucks, pallets, shipments) and for how long
How_Calculated: Snapshot of everything waiting in the site process at the last refresh: trucks on site (trlr / trlract, not dispatched), pallets in non-storage locations (inventory_view + locmst, stage rules from config/process_stages.csv) and open shipments (shipment status). Age = minutes in the current stage (status change / last pallet move) at the snapshot. Stage status: CRITICAL when an item is older than Crit_Min, WARNING older than Warn_Min, CLEAR = nothing waiting, N/A = stage not used at the site. Verdict = stage with the most items past critical.
How_To_Configure: Stages, order, limits (Warn_Min / Crit_Min), actions and owners: config/process_stages.csv (Site = <SiteCode> rows override '*'). Location rules use the site tokens of config/site_config.csv (AREA_RCV_DOCK, AREA_RDTS, LOC_LTA, LOC_HOFF_IN/OUT, LOC_EOL, LOC_TRAILER, LOC_DOOR_PATTERN, LOC_PROBLEM, LOC_RETURN). Status codes: config/trailer_status.csv, config/shipment_status.csv. Time bands: config/time_bands.csv. Rebuild after a change.

Purpose: Inbound / outbound trucks: where the truck time goes, dock and staging lanes, pallets per truck, full Gantt
How_Calculated: Per-truck charts = trucks completed (inbound dispatched / outbound closed) in the report shift day - same rule as the cockpit TTAT KPIs; before the first truck of the day completes they show the last shift day with completed trucks (the chart subtitle says which day). Per truck: wait = check-in to first scan, work = unload / load time, close-out = the rest of the TTAT. Distribution = trucks per TTAT band. By hour = trucks and average TTAT per hour. Trucks on site = live snapshot (status not Expected / Dispatched), past the stage warning age.
How_To_Configure: TTAT targets: Cfg_Threshold TTAT_IN / TTAT_OUT (or the Config & Health inputs). Bands: config/time_bands.csv. Truck stage limits / actions: config/process_stages.csv (T_IN_* / T_OUT_*). Status mapping: config/trailer_status.csv.

Purpose: Truck list with TTAT and process time for a date range (BD original)
How_Calculated: Inbound: check-in -> dispatch (TTAT) and first scan -> close (GR). Outbound: check-in -> close (TTAT) and loading start -> loaded (load time). Source: trlract + dlytrn.
How_To_Configure: Trailer codes / statuses are standard PrIME (RCV / SHIP / STO). SLA: Cfg_Threshold TTAT_IN / TTAT_OUT / GR_TIME.

Purpose: SAP production receipts vs PrIME production pallets
How_Calculated: SAP = finished-goods goods receipts against production orders (CDL silver_sap_a6p.matdoc, movement 101 minus reversals 102, material type FERT) of the site's SAP plant per posting day. Pallets = quantity / MARM factor of SAP_PALLET_UOM; a material without that unit counts one pallet per GR line (HU-managed plants post one GR per pallet - validated on Binh Duong against PrIME). PrIME = produced pallets per shift day. Coverage = PrIME / SAP over COMPARE_DAYS days.
How_To_Configure: Cfg_Site.SAP_Plant, Has_SAP_Prod and SAP_PALLET_UOM (config/site_config.csv). Coverage limit: Cfg_Threshold WMS_COVERAGE; window: COMPARE_DAYS. Texts: config/rca_rules.csv (SAP_*).

Purpose: Produced pallets per hour and line (BD original)
How_Calculated: Distinct pallets leaving each LTA takeaway location per hour (PalletsLeftFromLine) mapped to production line + department via Cfg_LineMap; CTMZ split by Cfg_Site.CTMZ_LINE.
How_To_Configure: Lines: Cfg_LineMap (Site, LTA_Source, Prod_Line, Category). Production transactions: Cfg_Site.PROD_TXN_FILTER.

Purpose: SAP-planned pallets per hour by line and market (BD original)
How_Calculated: SAP planned + process orders from CDL (plaf / afko / afpo) for SAP_Plant, converted to pallets with the replica footprint; market colour from the shipping destination (zr3ortec).
How_To_Configure: CDL connection: Cfg_Site Databricks_Host / Databricks_HttpPath (rebuild). Plant: Cfg_Site.SAP_Plant. Market colours: Cfg_Market. Off: Has_SAP_Plan = 0.

Purpose: Production lines vs their baseline with root cause + action; TTAT by shift
How_Calculated: Production lines (Excel LTA_MONITOR / LTA_RCA): pallets per line and hour of the report shift day; latest hour vs the average of the same hour over the last LOOKBACK days; status LINE DOWN / LOW OUTPUT / SURGE (thresholds MIN_BASE, PPH warning %, SURGE_FACTOR); root cause from the live constraints (free SHORT spots + LTA queue, Level A utilisation, HOFF backlog, idle hours) and the action (config/rca_rules.csv LINE_RCA). Empty at sites without production in PrIME. TTAT by shift (Excel ALERTS TTAT diagnostic): trucks completed (inbound dispatched / outbound closed) in the last LOOKBACK shift days, grouped by the shift of their check-in; wait = check-in to first scan, work = unload / load; the read says whether waiting or (un)loading is the delay.
How_To_Configure: Shift hours: Cfg_Site Shift1/2/3_Start (2 shifts: Shift3_Start = Shift2_Start). Baseline days: Cfg_Threshold LOOKBACK; line thresholds MIN_BASE, SURGE_FACTOR, RCA_IDLE_HOURS; TTAT limits TTAT_IN / TTAT_OUT; root-cause texts config/rca_rules.csv; line names config/line_map.csv.

Purpose: Produced vs planned vs shipped pallets per 4-hour bucket (BD original)
How_Calculated: Produced (pallets leaving LTA) vs planned (work-order pallets prorated into 4-hour buckets of the shift day) vs shipped (first LOAD event per LPN). Sync % above SYNC_CAP is treated as noise.
How_To_Configure: Bucket start: Cfg_Site.ShiftDay_Start_Min. Cap: Cfg_Threshold SYNC_CAP / BUCKET_HOURS.

Purpose: Open replenishments short for production (BD original)
How_Calculated: Live list (right now): open replenishments (rplwrk) for work orders with the WH stock that could cover them (excluding end-of-line locations LOC_EOL / LOC_EOL_EXACT).
How_To_Configure: End-of-line locations: Cfg_Site LOC_EOL / LOC_EOL_EXACT. Off: Has_Production = 0.

Purpose: Material (RPM) pallets required vs delivered per work order
How_Calculated: Component (RPM) pallets required vs delivered per work order in the WO_WINDOW_DAYS window; JIT flag from the RPM master files; material master and stock as they are now (live).
How_To_Configure: RPM master files: Cfg_Site RPM_Folder / RPM_*_File, switch on with Has_RPM_Master = 1 (file must be reachable by the refresh: SharePoint / gateway).

Purpose: Work-line activity per pallet (BD original)
How_Calculated: Work-line activity per LPN: LTA receipts, returns, WCS ALTA, supply to production and production check-in.
How_To_Configure: Locations: Cfg_Site LOC_PROD_SUPPLY / LOC_PROD_CHECKIN.

Purpose: Pallets moved per hour and process step; area-to-area flows
How_Calculated: Pallets moved = RF pallet transactions per user-hour (User Activity, a pallet counted once per user and hour), split by process step (config/movement_classes.csv: activity / operation codes and location rules). Status / system events are excluded. Waiting pallets = Pallets In Flow snapshot by stage and time in location. Area flows = distinct pallets moved between two different areas in the report shift day (Pallets Movement).
How_To_Configure: Process steps, codes and chart colours: config/movement_classes.csv. Excluded users: Cfg_Site.USR_EXCLUDE. Pallet stage rules / limits: config/process_stages.csv. Days of history: Cfg_Site.ACT_DAYS / MOVEMENT_DAYS.

Purpose: Stock and storage space now; old stock with likely cause and action
How_Calculated: All pallets in stock now - finished goods AND materials (sql/new/Inventory.sql on inventory_view): by area (locmst), location class (receiving / shipping / production line / trailer / storage from the location type flags), WMS status (dscmst invsts) and age band (days since receipt date, else FIFO date: config/stock_age_bands.csv). Space = Location Utilisation (occupied vs all storage locations). Old stock = pallets in the age bands from STOCK_OLD_DAYS on (subtitle shows the number and share); likely cause and action per location class from config/stock_old_causes.csv (e.g. old pallets 'on trailer' = trailer never dispatched in WMS). Inv KPIs is the separate Level A view (sites with Has_LevelA = 1).
How_To_Configure: Age bands: config/stock_age_bands.csv; old stock age: Cfg_Threshold STOCK_OLD_DAYS; causes / actions: config/stock_old_causes.csv; finished goods = part numbers matching Cfg_Site FG_PRTNUM_LIKE; trailer locations: LOC_TRAILER; utilisation target: LOC_UTIL.

Purpose: Level A space, HOFF, LTA queues and 80/20 flows (BD original)
How_Calculated: Live inventory snapshot from the replica: Level A free SHORT / TALL spots (location height vs TALL_HEIGHT_CM), occupied FG / PM, HOFF IN / OUT, LTA queue and outbound pick source.
How_To_Configure: Patterns: Cfg_Site LOC_LEVEL_A, AREA_LEVEL_A_PICK, LOC_HOFF_IN / OUT, LOC_LTA, ZONES_EXCL_*. Turn the block off with Has_LevelA / Has_HOFF = 0.

Purpose: Open shipments by stage and age; created vs loaded
How_Calculated: Shipments created in the last ACT_DAYS days with their WMS status (description from dscmst). Open = not Load Complete / Cancelled / Transfer. Stage age = minutes since the status started (created / allocated / staged / loaded time). Late = open and past the late ship date. If no shipment ever moves beyond Ready the order stages are N/A (site runs outbound on trailer loading).
How_To_Configure: Status -> stage, open flag and age start: config/shipment_status.csv. Limits / actions: config/process_stages.csv (O_*). History window: Cfg_Site.ACT_DAYS.

Purpose: Order -> pick -> load -> truck: where the flow loses time, measured
How_Calculated: Process mining of the last MOVEMENT_DAYS days (the subtitle shows the number) from the WMS event logs (sql/new/Process Edges.sql): ORDER = shipment created -> pick released (allocated) -> picked & staged -> loaded -> truck dispatched (shipment -> stop -> car_move -> trailer); PALLET = LPN through the process steps of config/movement_classes.csv (dlytrn; the first move after the pallet arrives counts as its put-away, whatever code the site books it with); TRUCK = check-in -> (un)loading -> closed -> dispatched (trlract). Consecutive repeats of a step are one step. Every hand-off is Forward (main sequence), Storage (put-away -> next step = stock waiting for demand, not a process wait), Back (to an earlier step = rework / return), Side (a transfer / other move = extra handling, Flow_Role SIDE) or Open ('Open: waiting after X' = not yet at the next step now = stuck). Median / p95 are over cases (each pallet / order / truck counts once). Sankeys = the main flow (Forward + Storage + Open), width = distinct cases, hand-offs below PM_MIN_CASES hidden; Side and Back hand-offs are in the ranked table. Bottleneck = Forward hand-off with the largest total waiting time (cases x median). Truck Gantt = completed trucks of the report shift day (else the last day with completed trucks, see subtitle) on one timeline from the first check-in: wait (amber) + unload / load (blue) + close-out (grey). Flow alerts = the Inbound / Outbound alert rules with actual vs target and why.
How_To_Configure: Process steps, colours and Flow_Role (IN / PUTAWAY / STEP / SIDE): config/movement_classes.csv; order statuses: config/shipment_status.csv; window: Cfg_Site.MOVEMENT_DAYS; noise floor: Cfg_Threshold PM_MIN_CASES; TTAT targets: TTAT_IN / TTAT_OUT. The order flow is hidden where shipments stay Ready in WMS (Orders Flow Used).

Purpose: Who moves how many pallets: by hour vs target, per user (main process step), user x hour
How_Calculated: Pallets moved (distinct LPN) per RF user per hour from dlytrn on the report day; productivity = pallets / active user-hours. System / automatic activity codes are excluded; users in USR_EXCLUDE are excluded.
How_To_Configure: Standard: threshold input USER_PROD on Config & Health (or Cfg_Threshold USER_PROD). Exclude users: Cfg_Site.USR_EXCLUDE. Look-back days: Cfg_Site.ACT_DAYS.

Purpose: Data health, feed completeness, targets in use, site registry
How_Calculated: Data health: replica freshness (newest dlytrn vs site clock), feed completeness and accuracy rules (Excel VALIDATION) for the site picked in the Site slicer. Threshold inputs: type a number in a box to override that KPI's target / warning / critical level for everyone using this report; empty box = the saved Cfg_Threshold value (column 'Source'). Units: plt = pallets, plt/h = pallets per hour, locs = storage locations, min = minutes, h = hours, % = share.
How_To_Configure: Threshold boxes: type the value, press Enter (Desktop: save the file / Service: the value is kept as your view - use 'Reset to default' to clear). Permanent values per site: Home > Transform data > Cfg_Threshold > Source (gear) > edit > Close & Apply. Site registry: config/site_config.csv + rebuild (static server / database per site = Service-safe). Units of chart values: config/measure_units.csv and column_units.csv (rebuild).

Purpose: Every field: meaning, unit, colour rule and source
How_Calculated: One row per field of the diagnosis pages: meaning / calculation, unit of measure, grouping and colour rule, source table. The same text is the tooltip of the measure in the field list.
How_To_Configure: Edit config/field_guide.csv (column Measure = model measure that gets the description) and rebuild.

Purpose: Question templates for Copilot: what to ask, an example to copy, what you get
How_Calculated: Each template is answered from two tables built at every refresh: KPI Scorecard (site x KPI: value, target, status, forecast, action, owner) and Site Summary (site: state, main constraint, action plan, data as of). Copilot's AI instructions tell it how to answer each template.
How_To_Configure: Edit config/copilot_questions.csv (Template, Example, Answer = this page; Steps = the answer recipe in the AI instructions) and rebuild.
